route_notes: Suggested visit order only, based on the 28 October 2026 itinerary. Not a guarantee of opening, stock, kitchen service or transport; alternatives replace rather than extend the route. No Saturday pub crawl.

routes.title: Mon 9 · Arrival evening
routes.note: Marble Arch only if the flight and transfer permit. Monday kitchen last orders were published as 20:00; Tuesday closed. Dinner may need to be elsewhere.

stops.note: If flight arrival permits; do not assume a meal.

routes.title: Tue 10 · Historic Manchester
routes.note: Lunch at Mr Thomas's then a manageable central heritage-and-cask route. Café Beermoth or Fell is an alternative evening add-on, not an extra compulsory stop.

stops.note: Lunch and tiled interior; confirm kitchen.
Ask for mild or a well-kept local bitter.
Green tiles, historic rooms and bell pushes.
Cask and Little Pomona cider lead; check actual product.

routes.title: Wed 11 · Stockport
routes.note: Stockport's beer/cider-and-heritage day. Magnet is a later opener. The Old Tom seasonal cask is only a possible remaining pint after its 7 November launch.

stops.note: Lunch and historic snug; confirm kitchen hours.
Ask for the cellar, fridge and perry list.
Later-opening cask specialist; don't assume Wednesday pizza.

routes.title: Thu 12 · Liverpool Dale Street
routes.note: Arrival in Liverpool; compare splendid rooms with specialist cask. The Wirral Beer Festival is an evening alternative, not a fourth mandatory pub.

stops.note: Grand Edwardian interior and returned cask.
Magnificent tiled corridor; real cider lead.
World beer, real cider and possible food; confirm kitchen.

routes.title: Fri 13 · Liverpool Georgian Quarter
routes.note: Roscoe Head was advertised for sale September 2026: sale is not closure, but reconfirm operation. Travel back to Manchester on Friday night if following the preferred hotel pattern.

stops.note: Trading must be reconfirmed after 2026 sale notice.
Extra walking for remarkable murals and drinking tables.
